lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p1-2 - A Listen, point and say

details: Listen, point and say checks understanding of initial letter sounds. Listen and point shows students can match what they hear to the right image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.
“We’re having a party and we have to check everyone has arrived! Can you say each letter as they come in.. Let’s make sure we welcome them all.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book p.101-102 - A Follow the maze

details: Follow the maze develops early decoding and reading skills. Students practise initial letter sounds while navigating a letter maze from A to Z, reinforcing clear pronunciation and letter recognition.
Look for clear pronunciation, steady pacing, accurate identification of each letter, and confident progression through the A–Z maze.
“The letters have been playing a party game and they are stuck inside a maze . Can you rescue them?”
